The '''KD49 repulsorlift drive unit''' was a type of [[Repulsor coil/Legends|repulsor coil]] manufactured by [[Karydee]] for the [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EV" />
